experiment: bounded parked-cash purpose and priority comparison

cash_policy.cap_definition: Sum of exact P-funded acquisition basis in surviving lots plus pending P claims. Settlement retires acquisition basis exactly once; returns require fresh authorization.
cash_policy.partial_proceeds: All net partial proceeds return to PARK exactly once, as in native control.
cash_policy.whole_proceeds: Exact P-funded ownership fraction returns to PARK; ordinary-funded remainder rotates as in native control.
cash_policy.priority: Original EXIT then PARTIAL_RECYCLE then RECOVERY then ENTRY. Native recovery planning priority is preserved; no new adaptive ranking is implied.

unchanged.entry_selection: Original causal movement and recorded-volume ranking; not a predictive winner selector.
unchanged.recovery_selection: Original fingerprint/recovery/tranche planners; no new ladder or signal overlay.

stops: No authentic parked-funded buy in enabled activation window
execution.result_selection: Compare complete window marked equity, change in open P&L, cash, source utilization, drawdown, and fees. Do not select by realized profit alone.

limits: This July continuation is a bounded mechanism and policy comparison, not a new January-June backtest.
The period and original native baseline were previously inspected; this is not an untouched performance holdout.
No new freshness/history gate, predictive winner model, live execution or thirty-second execution guarantee is tested.
A good result warrants longer validation; it does not approve deployment or guarantee profitability.
